sloka: समाजश्च मया दृष्टो गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनः ।पिबतां रक्तमाल्यानां रक्षसां रक्तवाससाम् ।। ५.२७.३४।।।।
transliteration: samājaśca mayā dṛṣṭo gītavāditraniḥsvanaḥ ।pibatāṁ raktamālyānāṁ rakṣasāṁ raktavāsasām ।। 5.27.34।।।।

translations.english: " A large group of demons was seen collected together, drinking, wearing red garlands and red clothes, singing and playing musical instruments.
